title: IMPR-01: Implement the ym=YYYY-MM partition contract with watermark-driven incremental refresh
description: Execute the ADR 2026-11-13 - Partition contract (ym=YYYY-MM) and watermark-driven incremental refresh. Design is committed; this project is the implementation wave. Removes the 20-30 min full vault rebuild on any new month input and replaces TRUNCATE+COPY sink with INSERT ON CONFLICT. Prerequisite: PROJ-20261114-wi1-metrics reaches phase=DONE.
source_request: User directive 2026-11-18: 'make the 3 suggestions I gave are also looked into and implemented if needed'. Orchestrator evaluation: IMPR-01 marked IMPLEMENT (strong PDF section 3 trace, design already committed as ADR, pure execution ahead). Full rationale in multi-agent-engineering/improvements_backlog.md IMPR-01 entry. Gate: PROJ-20261114-wi1-metrics must reach phase=DONE before this project advances past PENDING.

upstream_design.adr_id: 2026-11-13 - Partition contract (ym=YYYY-MM) and watermark-driven incremental refresh
scope_summary: pipeline_watermarks(layer, table_name, last_ym, row_count, updated_at) table
Partition every parquet tree on ym=YYYY-MM (keep hub_aircraft, hub_airport, sat_aircraft_identity non-partitioned with a tiny compaction pass)
Vault: filter bronze by ym > last_ym; write per-month shards
Marts: per-month build, append to partitioned tree
Sink: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT per target per month (replaces TRUNCATE + COPY)
Matrix: add ym column + unique (ym, source, method, noise), ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
eval_mart: become a view or incremental materialized view
Zero-reprocess migration: one-shot pyarrow pass per existing monolithic part.parquet split by extracted ym
risks_from_adr: Cross-month flights (same hk_flight in two ym partitions) - reader-side merge rule, already specified
Small-hub uniqueness drift - compaction pass enforces
ym extraction asymmetry: flightlist bronze has in-file day; state bronze has it in the partition path
Watermark vs filesystem drift - startup QA check in run_e2e refuses to start if they disagree
